function.name: impl_from_IMoniker
function.description: This function returns the containing record for the given interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is used to specify the interface from which the containing record is to be obtained.

function.return_type: ClassMoniker*. It represents the containing record for the given interface.

function.name: impl_from_IROTData
function.description: This function returns a pointer to the ClassMoniker structure that contains the given IROTData interface pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IROTData interface

function.return_type: ClassMoniker pointer, representing the ClassMoniker structure that contains the IROTData interface

function.name: unsafe_impl_from_IMoniker
function.description: This function checks if the vtable of the given IMoniker interface is the same as that of the ClassMoniker. If it is, it returns the containing record of the interface, otherwise it returns NULL.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface whose vtable is to be checked and from which the containing record is to be returned.

function.return_type: ClassMoniker*. This represents the containing record of the given interface if the vtable matches that of the ClassMoniker, otherwise NULL.

function.name: ClassMoniker_QueryInterface
function.description: This function is used to query an interface of a ClassMoniker object. If the requested interface is supported, the function provides a pointer to that interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface of the ClassMoniker object.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested.

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: Address of the pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid. Upon successful return, *ppvObject contains the requested interface pointer. If the object does not support the interface, *ppvObject is set to NULL.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the function fails, it returns an error code. For example, if *ppvObject is NULL, it returns E_POINTER. If the requested interface is not supported, it returns E_NOINTERFACE.

function.name: ClassMoniker_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the ClassMoniker object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMoniker interface object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after the increment.

function.name: ClassMoniker_Release
function.description: This function releases the ClassMoniker object and decrements the reference count. If the reference count is zero, it releases the marshal and frees the data and the moniker itself.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer to the ClassMoniker object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the updated reference count after the decrement operation.

function.name: ClassMoniker_GetClassID
function.description: This function checks if the pointer to the class identifier (CLSID) is null. If not, it assigns the CLSID of the ClassMoniker to the pointer and returns a success code.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface

parameters.name: pClassID
parameters.description: Pointer to the class identifier (CLSID)

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns E_POINTER if pClassID is NULL, otherwise returns S_OK

function.name: ClassMoniker_IsDirty
function.description: This function checks if the OLE-provided implementations of the IPersistStream::IsDirty method in the OLE-provided moniker interfaces has changed its internal state.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Always returns S_FALSE because their internal state never changes.

function.name: ClassMoniker_Load
function.description: This function loads a ClassMoniker from a given stream. It reads the header and data from the stream into the moniker. If the data length in the header is non-zero, it allocates memory for the data and reads it from the stream.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the ClassMoniker to be loaded.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Pointer to the stream from which the ClassMoniker is to be loaded.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, STG_E_READFAULT if there is a read error, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails.

function.name: ClassMoniker_Save
function.description: This function saves the class moniker to a stream. If the moniker's header has data, it writes that data to the stream as well.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the class moniker to be saved

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Pointer to the stream where the class moniker will be saved

parameters.name: clear_dirty
parameters.description: Boolean value indicating whether to clear the dirty flag after saving

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code

function.name: ClassMoniker_GetSizeMax
function.description: This function calculates the size of the moniker and assigns it to the size parameter.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMoniker interface, used to get the implementation of the ClassMoniker.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Pointer to a ULARGE_INTEGER structure that receives the size of the ClassMoniker.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the function. Returns S_OK if the function succeeds.

function.name: ClassMoniker_BindToObject
function.description: This function binds a class moniker to an object. It either directly gets the class object if there is no left moniker, or it uses the left moniker to bind to the object and then gets the class object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface used to bind to the object.

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the bind context.

parameters.name: pmkToLeft
parameters.description: Pointer to the moniker to the left of this moniker.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface to be used.

parameters.name: ppvResult
parameters.description: Pointer to the location where the result is to be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, it returns S_OK. If it failed, it returns an error code.

function.name: ClassMoniker_BindToStorage
function.description: This function binds an object to a specified storage using the IMoniker interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the IBindCtx interface

parameters.name: pmkToLeft
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface to bind to the left

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface

parameters.name: ppvResult
parameters.description: Pointer to the result of the binding operation

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the binding operation

function.name: ClassMoniker_Reduce
function.description: This function reduces a class moniker and returns the reduced moniker. If the reduction is not possible, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the moniker to be reduced

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the bind context used for moniker binding operations

parameters.name: dwReduceHowFar
parameters.description: Specifies how far the moniker should be reduced

parameters.name: ppmkToLeft
parameters.description: Pointer to the moniker to the left of the reduced moniker

parameters.name: ppmkReduced
parameters.description: Pointer to the reduced moniker

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If successful, it returns MK_S_REDUCED_TO_SELF. If the reduction is not possible, it returns E_POINTER

function.name: ClassMoniker_ComposeWith
function.description: This function composes a new moniker by combining two existing monikers. If the second moniker is an anti-moniker, the function returns S_OK. If the 'only_if_not_generic' parameter is TRUE and the moniker is not generic, the function returns MK_E_NEEDGENERIC. Otherwise, it creates a generic composite moniker.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the first moniker to be composed

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: Pointer to the second moniker to be composed

parameters.name: only_if_not_generic
parameters.description: Flag indicating whether the function should return an error if the moniker is generic

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to receive the composed moniker

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It can be S_OK if the operation was successful, E_POINTER if the result or right pointers are NULL, MK_E_NEEDGENERIC if the 'only_if_not_generic' parameter is TRUE and the moniker is generic, or the result of the 'CreateGenericComposite' function

function.name: ClassMoniker_Enum
function.description: This function checks if the pointer to the IEnumMoniker interface is NULL. If it is, it returns an error; otherwise, it sets the pointer to NULL and returns a success code.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface

parameters.name: fForward
parameters.description: Boolean value indicating the direction of enumeration

parameters.name: ppenumMoniker
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to the IEnumMoniker interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns E_POINTER if ppenumMoniker is NULL, otherwise it returns S_OK.

function.name: ClassMoniker_IsEqual
function.description: This function checks if two IMoniker interfaces are equal by comparing their GUIDs.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: The first IMoniker interface to compare.

parameters.name: other
parameters.description: The second IMoniker interface to compare.

function.return_type: HRESULT, where the return value is S_OK if the GUIDs are equal, S_FALSE if they are not equal, and E_INVALIDARG if the 'other' parameter is NULL.

function.name: ClassMoniker_Hash
function.description: This function calculates the hash of a ClassMoniker object by using the Data1 field of the clsid in the header of the object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMoniker interface which is used to get the ClassMoniker object

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: Pointer to a DWORD variable where the calculated hash will be stored

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK indicates success

function.name: ClassMoniker_IsRunning
function.description: This function is a placeholder for a function that checks if a class moniker is running. Currently, it is not implemented.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the class moniker

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the bind context

parameters.name: pmkToLeft
parameters.description: Pointer to the moniker to the left of the current moniker

parameters.name: pmkNewlyRunning
parameters.description: Pointer to the newly running moniker

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns E_NOTIMPL indicating the function is not implemented.

function.name: ClassMoniker_GetTimeOfLastChange
function.description: This function is used to get the time of the last change of the ClassMoniker.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface used for the function

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the bind context

parameters.name: pmkToLeft
parameters.description: Pointer to the moniker to the left

parameters.name: pItemTime
parameters.description: Pointer to the file time structure to receive the time of the last change

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call, in this case it always returns MK_E_UNAVAILABLE indicating that the requested information is not available

function.name: ClassMoniker_Inverse
function.description: This function inverses a class moniker and creates an anti-moniker if the provided pointer is not null.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the moniker that needs to be inversed

parameters.name: ppmk
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to receive the anti-moniker

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns E_POINTER if ppmk is NULL, otherwise returns the result of CreateAntiMoniker function

function.name: ClassMoniker_CommonPrefixWith
function.description: This function checks if two monikers have the same class identifier (CLSID). If they do, it sets the prefix to the interface of the first moniker and returns MK_S_US. If they don't, it returns MK_E_NOPREFIX. If the second moniker is not a class moniker, it delegates the operation to MonikerCommonPrefixWith.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the first moniker interface

parameters.name: other
parameters.description: Pointer to the second moniker interface

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer that receives the common prefix moniker

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns MK_S_US if the operation is successful, MK_E_NOPREFIX if the monikers do not have the same CLSID, or the result of MonikerCommonPrefixWith if the second moniker is not a class moniker

function.name: ClassMoniker_RelativePathTo
function.description: This function is used to determine the relative path to a class moniker. However, it always returns an error indicating that the operation is not bindable.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the class moniker.

parameters.name: pmOther
parameters.description: Pointer to another class moniker.

parameters.name: ppmkRelPath
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer where the relative path would be stored if the operation was successful.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the operation. In this case, it always returns MK_E_NOTBINDABLE indicating that the operation is not bindable.

function.name: ClassMoniker_GetDisplayName
function.description: This function retrieves the display name of a class moniker. It checks for valid parameters, allocates memory for the name, formats the name using the class identifier (CLSID), and appends any additional data.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface of the class moniker.

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the IBindCtx interface used to bind to objects.

parameters.name: pmkToLeft
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface of the moniker to the left of this moniker.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Pointer to a string that receives the display name.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It can return S_OK on success, E_POINTER if the name parameter is NULL, E_INVALIDARG if the pmkToLeft parameter is not NULL, or E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails.

function.name: ClassMoniker_ParseDisplayName
function.description: This function parses a display name into a moniker using the IParseDisplayName interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the IBindCtx interface

parameters.name: pmkToLeft
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface to the left of the display name being parsed

parameters.name: display_name
parameters.description: Pointer to the display name to be parsed

parameters.name: eaten
parameters.description: Pointer to a ULONG where the number of characters successfully parsed from the display name will be returned

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an IMoniker interface where the resulting parsed moniker will be returned

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. S_OK indicates success and any other value indicates failure.

function.name: ClassMoniker_IsSystemMoniker
function.description: This function checks if the system moniker is a class moniker and sets the value of the second parameter to MKSYS_CLASSMONIKER if it is not null.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface used in the function

parameters.name: pwdMksys
parameters.description: Pointer to a DWORD that will be set to MKSYS_CLASSMONIKER if it is not null

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, E_POINTER if pwdMksys is null

function.name: ClassMonikerROTData_QueryInterface
function.description: This function queries an interface from the ClassMoniker object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IROTData interface of the ClassMoniker object.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested.

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid. Upon successful return, *ppvObject contains the requested interface pointer. If the object does not support the interface, *ppvObject is set to NULL.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the interface query. If the interface is supported, the method returns S_OK. If not, it returns E_NOINTERFACE.

function.name: ClassMonikerROTData_AddRef
function.description: This function adds a reference to the ClassMoniker object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IROTData interface of the ClassMoniker object

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the ClassMoniker object

function.name: ClassMonikerROTData_Release
function.description: This function releases the interface pointer to the ClassMoniker object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer to the ClassMoniker object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count. This value is intended to be used for test purposes only.

function.name: ClassMonikerROTData_GetComparisonData
function.description: This function gets comparison data for a ClassMoniker object in the Running Object Table (ROT). It writes the CLSID of the moniker and the CLSID the moniker represents into a byte array.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the ROT data

parameters.name: pbData
parameters.description: Pointer to the byte array where the comparison data will be written

parameters.name: cbMax
parameters.description: The maximum number of bytes that can be written to pbData

parameters.name: pcbData
parameters.description: Pointer to a ULONG where the function writes the actual number of bytes written to pbData

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, E_OUTOFMEMORY if there is not enough space to write the data

function.name: create_class_moniker
function.description: This function creates a class moniker object, initializes it, and returns a pointer to its IMoniker interface.

parameters.name: clsid
parameters.description: Pointer to the CLSID of the class moniker.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the data to be assigned to the class moniker.

parameters.name: data_len
parameters.description: Length of the data to be assigned to the class moniker.

parameters.name: moniker
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an IMoniker interface, which will be set to point to the created class moniker's IMoniker interface.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK on success, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails.

function.name: CreateClassMoniker
function.description: This function creates a class moniker that uniquely identifies a Component Object Model (COM) class.

parameters.name: rclsid
parameters.description: This is the CLSID of the COM class.

parameters.name: moniker
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer to the IMoniker interface on the class moniker.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns the result of the 'create_class_moniker' function.

function.name: ClassMoniker_CreateFromDisplayName
function.description: This function creates a class moniker from a display name.

parameters.name: pbc
parameters.description: Pointer to the bind context interface

parameters.name: display_name
parameters.description: Pointer to the display name string

parameters.name: eaten
parameters.description: Pointer to the number of characters eaten

parameters.name: moniker
parameters.description: Pointer to the created class moniker

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call, success or specific type of failure

function.name: ClassMoniker_CreateInstance
function.description: This function creates an instance of a class moniker.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the class factory interface

parameters.name: pUnk
parameters.description: Pointer to the IUnknown interface of the aggregate

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface that the caller is to use to communicate with the new object

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, the return value is S_OK. Otherwise, it is an error code
